snapshot_query:
SELECT JSON_QUERY(COALESCE((SELECT CONVERT(int,dwQuestID) AS dwQuestID,CONVERT(int,dwParentID) AS dwParentID,CONVERT(int,bType) AS bType,CONVERT(int,bForceRun) AS bForceRun,CONVERT(int,bTriggerType) AS bTriggerType,CONVERT(int,dwTriggerID) AS dwTriggerID,CONVERT(int,bCountMax) AS bCountMax,CONVERT(int,bLevel) AS bLevel,CONVERT(int,bMain) AS bMain,CONVERT(int,bConditionCheck) AS bConditionCheck FROM dbo.TQUESTCHART WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE dwQuestID IN(10519,10528,10529,10567,10598,10616,10617,11012,11013,11014,11015,11016,11017,11018,11019,11020,11021,11022,11025,11026,11027,11028,11029,11030,11033,11036,11037,11038,11079,11083,11084,11085,11086,40007930,40007931,40007932) ORDER BY dwQuestID,dwParentID,bType,bForceRun,bTriggerType,dwTriggerID,bCountMax,bLevel,bMain,bConditionCheck FOR JSON PATH),N'[]')) AS headers,
JSON_QUERY(COALESCE((SELECT CONVERT(int,dwQuestID) AS dwQuestID,CONVERT(int,bTermType) AS bTermType,CONVERT(int,dwTermID) AS dwTermID,CONVERT(int,bCount) AS bCount FROM dbo.TQUESTTERMCHART WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE dwQuestID IN(10519,10528,10529,10567,10598,10616,10617,11012,11013,11014,11015,11016,11017,11018,11019,11020,11021,11022,11025,11026,11027,11028,11029,11030,11033,11036,11037,11038,11079,11083,11084,11085,11086,40007930,40007931,40007932) ORDER BY dwQuestID,bTermType,dwTermID,bCount FOR JSON PATH),N'[]')) AS terms,
JSON_QUERY(COALESCE((SELECT CONVERT(int,dwQuestID) AS dwQuestID,CONVERT(int,bConditionType) AS bConditionType,CONVERT(int,dwConditionID) AS dwConditionID,CONVERT(int,bCount) AS bCount FROM dbo.TQCONDITIONCHART WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE dwQuestID IN(10519,10528,10529,10567,10598,10616,10617,11012,11013,11014,11015,11016,11017,11018,11019,11020,11021,11022,11025,11026,11027,11028,11029,11030,11033,11036,11037,11038,11079,11083,11084,11085,11086,40007930,40007931,40007932) ORDER BY dwQuestID,bConditionType,dwConditionID,bCount FOR JSON PATH),N'[]')) AS conditions,
JSON_QUERY(COALESCE((SELECT CONVERT(int,dwQuestID) AS dwQuestID,CONVERT(int,bRewardType) AS bRewardType,CONVERT(int,dwRewardID) AS dwRewardID,CONVERT(int,bTakeMethod) AS bTakeMethod,CONVERT(int,bTakeData) AS bTakeData,CONVERT(int,bCount) AS bCount,CONVERT(int,dwQuestMob) AS dwQuestMob,CONVERT(int,dwQuestTime) AS dwQuestTime,CONVERT(int,dwQuestPathMob) AS dwQuestPathMob,CONVERT(int,dwTicketID) AS dwTicketID,CONVERT(int,bSendQ) AS bSendQ FROM dbo.TQREWARDCHART WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE dwQuestID IN(10519,10528,10529,10567,10598,10616,10617,11012,11013,11014,11015,11016,11017,11018,11019,11020,11021,11022,11025,11026,11027,11028,11029,11030,11033,11036,11037,11038,11079,11083,11084,11085,11086,40007930,40007931,40007932) ORDER BY dwQuestID,bRewardType,dwRewardID,bTakeMethod,bTakeData,bCount,dwQuestMob,dwQuestTime,dwQuestPathMob,dwTicketID,bSendQ FOR JSON PATH),N'[]')) AS rewards FOR JSON PATH,WITHOUT_ARRAY_WRAPPER;
